# ProScan PDF

> ProScan PDF is a private document scanner and PDF toolkit for iPhone and iPad. Core document processing happens locally on the user's device. The app contains no ads and does not add watermarks.

Official website: [proscanpdf.com](https://proscanpdf.com/)

## Compared scanner apps

The sourced comparison evaluates ProScan PDF alongside these established iOS document-scanner apps:

- CamScanner
- Adobe Scan
- iScanner
- Scanner Pro by Readdle
- SwiftScan
- Genius Scan
- Tiny Scanner
- TurboScan

## Main capabilities

- Scan documents, receipts, IDs, photos, forms, black-and-white text and whiteboards.
- Choose from eight scanning modes: Document, Auto, Receipt, ID, Photo, Form, B&W Text and Whiteboard.
- Configure A4, Letter, Legal and other page sizes, portrait or landscape orientation, page numbers and timestamps.
- Capture text with Live OCR and extract editable text from scanned documents.
- Create searchable PDF copies and search their text in the PDF viewer.
- Convert PDFs to editable Word documents while preserving layout where possible.
- Convert photos to PDF and export PDF pages as images.
- Add colored text watermarks and compress scanned or image-based PDFs.
- Create passport and ID photos in exact sizes and printable photo sheets.
- Extract, reorder, insert or delete PDF pages and merge multiple PDFs.
- Add signatures and text form boxes, password-protect PDFs and share files.

## Privacy and storage

- Core scanning, OCR and PDF processing run on the device and can work offline.
- ProScan PDF does not upload user documents to its own servers.
- Files are stored in the app's local library for fast access.
- When iCloud is available, private backup copies can be stored in the user's iCloud account.
- iCloud backup and online sharing require a network connection.

## Availability

- Platforms: iPhone and iPad.
- Current documented version: 2.7.
- Free use: three free scans every day.
- Pro: optional plans unlock unlimited scanning and all Pro tools.
- Appearance: seven themes with matching app icons.
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Turkish, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Hindi.

## Important limitations

- PDF to Word preserves layout where possible; complex documents may not convert perfectly.
- Compression is optimized for scanned and image-based PDFs.
- iCloud availability depends on the user's Apple account, settings and network connection.
